name: app-icon

layers.notes: File and Dock icon while no service is on: the photographic halo alone on the black tile. Also icon-idle-1024.png (the master). Replaces Resources/AppIcon.icns.

Dock icon while at least one service is on: a dark planet rising from the bottom of the tile with the halo above it (the far half behind the planet, the near half in front). Also icon-active-1024.png. Replaces Resources/AppIconActive.icns.

idle.notes: Same use as AppIcon.icns: the file in Finder, Launchpad, and the Dock when nothing is on.

active.notes: Same use as AppIconActive.icns: NSApp.applicationIconImage while a DNS provider is active.

notes: Chosen variant: 2 'Photo halo, the same composition' (previews/28-app-icon). Composition, tile (824 pt rounded square on the 1024 grid, corner radius 185, soft drop shadow, hairline edge) and the planet are exactly as in the current icons; only the halo is the new photographic one without the bright hot spot and vertical line (rendered at 4 px per point, 1344x776, so it stays sharp at 1024) and with a little more exposure so the ring reads at small sizes. Black and white only. Every size of the .icns is scaled down from the 1024 master. Files: 2 x ~0.74 MB .icns + 2 x ~0.33 MB 1024 PNG. No metadata. The app code in scripts/make_icon/main.swift draws the old halo and is not needed any more for these two files: copy the .icns into Resources/ under the old names.
